title: AssistantTestResponse
description:
Response model containing complete assistant test information.

Returns all test configuration details including evaluation criteria,
scheduling, and metadata. Used when retrieving individual tests or
after creating/updating tests.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the test was created.
created_at.title: Created At

description.description: Detailed description of the test's purpose and scope.
description.title: Description

instructions.description: Detailed test scenario instructions and objectives.
instructions.title: Instructions

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum allowed duration for test execution in seconds.
max_duration_seconds.title: Max Duration Seconds

rubric.description: Evaluation criteria used to assess test performance.

criteria.description: Specific guidance on how to assess the assistant’s performance for this rubric item.

name.description: Label for the evaluation criterion, e.g., Empathy, Accuracy, Clarity.

rubric.title: Rubric

telnyx_conversation_channel.description: Communication channel used for test execution.

test_id.description: Unique identifier for the assistant test.
test_id.title: Test Id

test_suite.description: Test suite grouping for organizational purposes.
test_suite.title: Test Suite
